references/deliberate-practice.md: Solve from the learner sheet alone, including its title, data, choices and permitted aids. Try a second admissible case that would change the answer. If it exists, ask for a bound or what extra observation distinguishes the cases. If fixed requirements contradict one another, show the conflict and give a feasible alternative with the changed assumption explicit. When difficulty lies in choosing a method, remove cues from headings, intermediate questions and the visible rubric. Check the exact sheet again after editing.
